en: A black-and-white photograph showing a large castle or palace situated on a hill above a European town beside a river. In the foreground, a steamship or paddle steamer is making its way along the river. Distinctive historic buildings with steeply pitched roofs line the riverside below the castle. People can be seen walking along the river promenade. There is a sign on one building that appears to say 'Vereinshaus'. The landscape in the background consists of rolling hills and farmland.
